info.name: Daisy AI Analysis API
info.description:
Complete API collection for DAISY AI Tool - Healthcare Questionnaire Analysis System

This collection includes all endpoints for:
- PDF questionnaire analysis
- Result retrieval by professional ID
- Result retrieval by professional and patient ID
- Manual result saving
- Database health monitoring

request.description:
Dedicated Prompt 1 analysis endpoint. Accepts only files (PDF, .doc, .docx) — prompt type is fixed to Prompt_1 and does not need to be passed as a parameter.

**Request:**
- Method: POST
- Body: multipart/form-data
  - `files` (required): one or more PDF / Word documents

**Response:** `Prompt1Result` JSON — sections A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3.

**Authentication:** Requires X-API-Key header.

request.description:
Dedicated Prompt 2 analysis endpoint. Accepts only files (PDF, .doc, .docx) — prompt type is fixed to Prompt_2 and does not need to be passed as a parameter.

**Request:**
- Method: POST
- Body: multipart/form-data
  - `files` (required): one or more PDF / Word documents

**Response:** `Prompt2Result` JSON — sections A1, A2, A3, A4a (with nested A4a1_ethos/A4a2_qest/A4a3_heta), A4b, A4c, A4d, A4e, A5.

**Authentication:** Requires X-API-Key header.

item.name: Get Summary Report by Document ID

variable.description: The unique document ID of the summary report

item.description: Endpoints for analyzing PDF questionnaires and saving results

item.name: Retrieval

request.description:
Retrieve all analysis results for a specific healthcare professional.

**Request:**
- Method: GET
- Path Parameter: professionalId (string)

**Response:**
- 200 OK: Array of Prompt1ResultEntity objects
- 404 Not Found: No results for this professional

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header

item.name: Get Results by Professional and Patient ID

request.description:
Retrieve analysis results for a specific professional-patient combination.

**Request:**
- Method: GET
- Path Parameters:
  - professionalId (string)
  - patientId (string)

**Response:**
- 200 OK: Array of matching Prompt1ResultEntity objects
- Empty array if no matches found

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header

item.description: Endpoints for retrieving stored analysis results

request.description:
Check the health status of connected databases.

**Request:**
- Method: GET
- No parameters required

**Response:**
- 200 OK: Database is healthy
- 503 Service Unavailable: Database issues detected
- 500 Internal Server Error: Health check failed

**Response Format:**
- Plain text message with primary and secondary database status

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header
